subject.title: fix(ui): show config path in overview snapshot (Fixes #53958)

question: Should OpenClaw accept the active config path in the Overview snapshot card, move it to Settings, or keep config-path discovery CLI-only?
rationale: The code path is narrow, but the linked issue explicitly leaves placement open and the PR makes an absolute local path more prominent in the UI.

options.title: Accept Overview Row
options.body: Land this UI-only approach after branch refresh and redacted real Control UI proof confirm the existing admin-scoped snapshot field renders correctly.

options.title: Move To Settings
options.body: Ask for the same existing `configPath` value to appear in a Settings or Config information area instead of the Overview snapshot card.

options.title: Keep CLI Only
options.body: Decline the UI exposure and rely on the already-merged CLI config-path command for troubleshooting.

recommendation.title: Accept Overview Row
recommendation.body: Land this UI-only approach after branch refresh and redacted real Control UI proof confirm the existing admin-scoped snapshot field renders correctly.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev has the strongest feature-history signal for the Overview view structure that would receive this visible row.
